entries.name: Polly
entries.summary: Polly adopts the Open Source Maintenance Fee. The fee applies only to the next major version released after 16 Nov 2026; existing versions stay free. The source licence (BSD-3-Clause) doesn't change.
entries.whoPays: Companies earning at least US$20,000 from a product or project that uses Polly: US$20 per month. Direct references only; Polly brought in by another library (for example Microsoft.Extensions.Http.Resilience) is exempt.

alternatives.note: Microsoft's resilience package uses Polly transitively, which the fee doesn't cover (MIT).
Stay on the current major version; existing versions are not subject to the fee.

entries.name: MediatR
entries.summary: From v13, MediatR is dual-licensed under RPL-1.5 and the Lucky Penny Software commercial licence. Earlier versions keep their original Apache-2.0 terms.
entries.whoPays: A paid licence is needed for commercial use above the free Community edition: free for companies under US$5M gross annual revenue, non-profits under US$5M budget, education and non-production use. A licence key is required either way.

entries.name: AutoMapper
entries.summary: From v15, AutoMapper is dual-licensed under RPL-1.5 and the Lucky Penny Software commercial licence. Earlier versions keep their original MIT terms.
entries.whoPays: A paid licence is needed for commercial use above the free Community edition: free for companies under US$5M gross annual revenue, non-profits under US$5M budget, education and non-production use. A licence key is required either way.

entries.name: MassTransit
entries.summary: MassTransit v9 is a commercial product from Massient; v9 packages use the Massient licence. The v8 line remains Apache-2.0.
entries.whoPays: Commercial use of v9 requires a Massient licence key; see massient.com for terms.

alternatives.note: Apache-2.0 line, still receiving patch releases (8.5.12 at the time of writing).

entries.name: FluentAssertions
entries.summary: From v8, FluentAssertions uses the Xceed Community Licence for non-commercial use; commercial use needs a paid Xceed licence. v7 remains Apache-2.0.
entries.whoPays: Any commercial use of v8+ requires a paid licence from Xceed (per developer, per year).
